01-briefing.png.name: 01-briefing.png
01-briefing.png.textSnippet: Here is what this hour holds, in order. First you set up your workbench, which takes about seven minutes and means finding your way around this website. Then you run a safety inspection on an ICT room
01-briefing.png.contentAnchor: Here is what this hour holds, in order. First you set up your workbench, which takes about seven minutes and means finding your way around this website. Then you run a safety inspection on an ICT room: four goes at it, and a harder fifth one if you want it. After that come twelve quick questions about what you can do already, which are not a test and cannot be failed. Then six questions about this hour, and your first unlock. It finishes with a card about what you build next, one marked question, and a screen that asks you how the hour went.
01-briefing.png.says: the welcome card pupils read together at the start of the hour

02-workbench.png.textSnippet: Look along the top of this screen, over on the right, for a small green word: Saved. You never press a save button here. Every time you answer something or finish a part of a lesson, this website writ
02-workbench.png.contentAnchor: Look along the top of this screen, over on the right, for a small green word: Saved. You never press a save button here. Every time you answer something or finish a part of a lesson, this website writes it to your own record, and that green word tells you it has landed. Your work follows your login, so you can pick it up on any school computer.
02-workbench.png.says: a workbench step — what to look for, and the box to tick

03-inspect-intro.png.textSnippet: Now you are the inspector. You will see a drawing of an ICT room after a class has left. Click any station you think breaks one of those rules to plant a flag on it. You can change your mind as often
03-inspect-intro.png.contentAnchor: Now you are the inspector. You will see a drawing of an ICT room after a class has left. Click any station you think breaks one of those rules to plant a flag on it. You can change your mind as often as you like, because nothing is marked until you file your report.
03-inspect-intro.png.says: the inspection opening card: the six rules, then how it works

04-inspect-scene.png.name: 04-inspect-scene.png
04-inspect-scene.png.textSnippet: Filing tells you which rule each flag breaks, and shows you anything you missed. A flag on a station that is fine costs you nothing.
04-inspect-scene.png.contentAnchor: Filing tells you which rule each flag breaks, and shows you anything you missed. A flag on a station that is fine costs you nothing.
04-inspect-scene.png.says: a room being inspected, before any station is flagged
